description: Exotic LookML coverage (branch tj/lookml-robustness-ratio-percentile-html-fixes). access_filter: the order_fact explore restricts ORDER_STATUS by the `allowed_status` user_attribute (row-level security) — detected and warned (recreate as Sigma RLS), the explore is converted normally and not dropped. many_to_many: the promo_dim join is relationship: many_to_many; Sigma has no native M:N, so it is mapped to the closest type (N:1) with a bridge-table warning and the relationship + joined dimension columns are retained (no dangling refs, >=1 relationship). A correctly-handled model produces a real relationship and zero error columns.
